scope: Correct and prove signed Resend delivered-event webhook reconciliation for the hosted shared-link alternate-recipient email.
providerActions: Resend dashboard showed the configured endpoint https://www.archestimator.com/api/webhooks/resend as Enabled.

Resend dashboard showed signed email.sent and email.delivered events for the alternate-recipient shared-link email attempting against the endpoint, with the selected pre-fix delivered event returning HTTP 400 Invalid webhook.
Copied the existing masked Resend signing secret without showing or recording the value; local validation recorded only the whsec_ prefix shape and character count.
Updated Vercel RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET for Production and Preview(main) from stdin, then cleared the clipboard.
Forced a fresh Vercel production deployment so the live webhook function used the corrected secret.
Replayed or retried the existing Resend delivered event after the new deployment was Ready.
A later Resend dashboard readback showed the delivered event as Success with HTTP 200 OK.

The proof closes signed delivered-event webhook reconciliation for the real hosted shared-link email.
